headline: SpaceX Stock Now Has $26 Billion in Short Bets — 35% of its Entire Float
summary: SpaceX stock now has 35% of its float sold short, with bears wagering more than $26 billion and pocketing $7.3 billion in profits so far.

headline: Microsoft Short Interest Hits Highest Level Since 2015 as Bears Dig in Ahead of Earnings
summary: Approximately 92 million Microsoft shares are currently sold short, the highest level since May 2015, heading into Wednesday's earnings release.
